patch_name: Regression Guardrails / Mirror Boundary Test Pack
description: Anchors ALETHEIA's mirror boundary through regression tests and a core architecture review note. Prevents UI, semantic, and receipt-layer expansion from silently weakening gate routing or creating false SANCTUARY paths.

recovery_note.action: If these tests fail after UI or semantic-layer changes, block the build and inspect routing before release.
recovery_note.boundary_check: Dangerous authority, capture, no-appeal, emergency-power, identity-gated-access, and opaque-capture inputs must not route to SANCTUARY. 9k and World Lens outputs remain audit lenses, not mandate claims.
